issue.detail: api.queue_call is dispatched before the call row/counter is reserved. An exception or interruption after possible native dequeue can leave no recorded attempt; cleanup drains can spend the same remaining slot again.
issue.demonstrated_fake_case: 1023 prior recorded rows; first fake invocation raises KeyboardInterrupt and is uncounted; a second invocation is permitted, producing recorded1024 despite1025 conservative possible attempts.
issue.unknown_packet_implication: A possibly dequeued packet can also be absent; future packet bounds must account conservatively for unknown outcomes, not only observed successful returns.

acknowledgement: The original peer review missed this pre-dispatch accounting gap. The original source/protocol/review remain immutable; this warning limits future reuse and universal call-budget claims.
timing: Root reports the once-only v1 execution had already occurred before the author late warning arrived.
actual_scope: Independent result verification records nine normal return rows with no observer API-exception/interruption evidence. The latent branch was not observed. Diagnostic remains negative; retained raw PID/counter observations are not rewritten.
future_requirements: new separately named/frozen version; no in-place edits or consumed-attempt rerun
durable counted attempt reservation before every native queue dispatch; failed reservation prevents dispatch
retained unknown-return state on exception/interruption; no invented raw outputs or PID interpretation
conservative possible-packet charge for unknown native return; no budget reset during cleanup
focused raising-queue tests at both call and packet boundaries; cleanup termination/reaping independent of observation budgets
exact source/protocol/pure/peer/root decision before any new attempt
